attributes.name: Blessing of Chaldira Zuzaristan
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

If you are the only character at your location, discard this card to add 2 dice to your check.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, if you have the Halfling trait, add 1d4 to your checks. 

After you play this card, if there are less than 5 cards in the blessings deck, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
